hotels.description: A relaxing stay at this sublime escape is the best way to uncover the coastal charms and soft sands of Mollymook Beach. Tucked away on the south coast of New South Wales, this laid-back escape is moments away from an abundance of breathtaking waterside walks, top-rated surf beaches, wildlife encounters and mouthwatering dining experiences. Located less than a three-hour drive from Sydney and Canberra, this tranquil, contemporary haven dials up luxury for an inviting atmosphere. Home to a sun-kissed rooftop pool, Bannisters Pavilion also offers world-class modern Australian fare served at The Rooftop Bar & Grill and immaculately styled rooms with a blend of coastal-inspired decor and contemporary furnishings. Venture out to explore the township of Milton and visit the antique shops, or indulge in the local culinary scene, offering the freshest seafood and locally sourced produce. To top it off, the hotel is only 80 metres from the beach, sheltered by swaying palm trees and exotic plants - this is coastal living at its finest.
